crossRefs.note: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them.…
This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
Yahweh sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you…
Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, “A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of the angel…
Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn…
But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and…
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak…
Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

translations.web: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?
translations.bsb: Then a man of God came to Eli and told him, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Did I not clearly reveal Myself to your father’s house when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh’s house?
translations.kjv: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh's house?
translations.asv: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Did I reveal myself unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh's house?
